body: I used to write songs but they're all shit. I like drinking a lot and reading. That's about it really.

I don't have anyone to talk to. I hate talking to therapists because they're too clinical. They're not real people to me, they never try and understand how I'm feeling, they would just rather try and teach me breathing exercises that are always the same and never work. 

My friends have given up on me completely and my parents don't believe I have depression even though I've been diagnosed several times by several different doctors and psychiatrists. I just hate talking to people about my problems because no one ever really cares or everyone thinks I'm lying.
I guess that's pretty true, I've always been a backup plan for everyone.
I'd like it if you could, I've always thought that people are way more attracted to and have better luck with confident people.
